mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending capacity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST < 900) and retail sales (RSAFS < 410000) indicate contracting consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 900 and RSAFS < 410000.

failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 98.0 in late-cycle regimes.
